objective: Executor-embedded resource budget enforcement for the governed training subprocess: cooperative step-boundary budgets (native_transformer/training/budget.py) already landed via self-learning-resource-overspend; this adds the external hard-stop layer.

bounded_keys.train_process_timeout_s: 0..86400, default 14400 — previously read from configuration but never normalized, so the configured value was silently dropped (always 14400); now an honored bounded key

monitor: per-tick process-tree RSS via psutil (leader + recursive children)
budget set but psutil unavailable -> EXECUTOR_RESOURCE_MONITOR_UNAVAILABLE before spawn (fail-closed)
deadline-aware wait slice so the timeout fires on time rather than at interval boundary
implementation.accounting: summary['resource'] = {peak_rss_mb, rss_budget_mb, rss_samples, elapsed_s} -> audit payload 'resource' (training-job-executed event)

new_cases: kills_subprocess_on_rss_overbudget (1MB cap, 14MB worker killed, train-error.json written)

fail_closed: overrun kills whole process tree, job transitions failed via existing executor error path
monitor unavailable + budget configured -> no training start
out-of-bounds budget values rejected at normalization
scope_note: VRAM/time step-boundary budgets are owned by native_transformer/training/budget.py (self_learning policy train_time_budget_s/train_vram_budget_mb). This layer covers host RSS and hard-kill semantics the cooperative checks cannot provide.
